descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S12 Two Hospital charts opened -> two access rows, each naming patient and physician

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Every patient access is recorded in the audit log and attributed to the signed-in physician. Each row has the patient, the physician, a timestamp and the action (view / save / generate / handoff send … (UAT OAT-01 step 5; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 7; TFA-94513 AC 12; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given AUDIT_USER signed in through the browser, with two Hospital patients

When Open chart A, then chart B

Then There is a PHI_READ row for each chart, with resource_id and patient_id equal to that patient, actor_id equal to the physician, context 'rounding.patient', and a creation time.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): audit.spec.ts assertions (presence per chart), judged against U5 for the 'view' action in Hospital. Whether PHI_READ is an acceptable spelling of 'view' is Q6; whether in-app chart opens are enough for 'every patient access' is Q14 (S15).

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S12

Two Hospital charts opened -> two access rows, each naming patient and physician

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-01.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • audit.spec.ts [chromium] — opening a chart in the browser records a PHI_READ row — expected
  • audit.spec.ts [chromium] — each chart opened in a session gets its own row — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright specs, which sign in their own fixture accounts and need the admin key; dev has neither (runner-contract §10), so this runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
